about: What farm program payments are worth to farmland: each state's average yearly government payments to farms over 2021 to 2025, its farm real estate value in dollars per acre (2025) and in total (2024), and the size of a typical cut in payments.

sources.payments: USDA Economic Research Service, Farm Income and Wealth Statistics, data as of September 3, 2026, variable "Value of government payments, total", state series, calendar years 2021 to 2025 (2026 is a forecast and left out), https://www.ers.usda.gov/data-products/farm-income-and-wealth-statistics/data-files-us-and-state-level-farm-income-and-wealth-statistics
sources.landValues: USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service, Land Values 2024 Summary (August 2025): farm real estate average value per acre 2025 and total value of land and buildings 2024, https://www.nass.usda.gov/Publications/Todays_Reports/reports/land0825.pdf
sources.capitalization: Goodwin, Mishra and Ortalo-Magne 2011, "Landowners' Riches: The Distribution of Agricultural Subsidies", NBER w16693: each $1 of payments per acre is worth $13 to $30 per acre of land value

typicalCut.basis: The median fall in total U.S. farm government payments in the years they fell since 1996, ERS Farm Income and Wealth Statistics: 2001 -3.4%, 2002 -44.7%, 2004 -21.5%, 2006 -35.3%, 2007 -24.6%, 2009 -0.5%, 2011 -15.9%, 2014 -11.2%, 2017 -11.2%, 2021 -43.1%, 2022 -40.0%, 2023 -21.2%, 2024 -17.7%
